Data.Name: initialText
Data.Data: CentComm Notice __________________________________ This is Barry Newheart from Customer Support, following up with your raised item regarding to the potiential Evacuation Shuttle Safety Violation. I'm afraid that the Evacuation Shuttle is performing correctly, the shuttlebombing is to do with the shuttle going off the docking position relative to the original Master Design. This Design cannot be updated to reflect the current upper docking area due to shuttlebombing ruining any newer alterations. If you would like to minimise damage to the station upon evacuation, it is recommended that you disassemble the upper corridor prior to the shuttle's arrival. Regards, Barry

Data.Name: initialText
Data.Data: CentComm Notice __________________________________ This is Barry Newheart from Customer Support, following up with your raised item regarding to the quote "SERIOUS Evacuation Shuttle Safety Violation". I'm afraid to once again inform you that the Evacuation Shuttle is performing correctly, the shuttlebombing is to do with the shuttle going off the docking position relative to the original Master Design. I must stress that this Design cannot be updated to reflect the current upper docking area due to shuttlebombing ruining any newer alterations. If you would like to minimise damage to the station upon evacuation, it is strongly recommended that you disassemble the upper corridor prior to the shuttle's arrival. Regards, Barry
